_comment: L3 conformance last-known run: the passing/failing scenario sets of the official TinkerPop cucumber suite (scoped by test/L3-conformance/tags.ts). `bun test` FAILS if a scenario in `passed` now fails (a regression) or the count drops; it auto-records the current run here on a clean local run (CI never rewrites). `passing` = passed.length is the ratchet floor. Commit this file with every bump. Never hand-edit `passed` to hide a regression.
